Process amendment to the drive-epic skill (operator directive 2026-08-17, present-tense): the skill must encode subscription min-maxing — idle lanes are direct financial loss. Edit ONLY agents_extensions/shared/skills/drive-epic/SKILL.md (git source; deploy trees are rsync-overwritten). Unit: ONE PR adding a binding section (place it as §2c 'No idle lanes — subscription min-max (binding, all driver seats)' right after §2b, and update the §Per-model table's generalization note) with these rules, tightly worded: (1) Every settle-wait, review-wait, and CI-wait is a dispatch opportunity: after firing any dispatch or review ask, BEFORE holding, the driver attempts to fill every free lane from the queue (next unblocked work item, banked follow-ups, next program child whose dependency allows prep work). Idle free lane + open queue item = utilization failure — this generalizes the existing Grok-seat fleet-first rule to ALL driver seats. (2) Pipeline the review loop: while a CF review or CI runs on unit N, the authoring lane takes unit N+1; never serialize implement→review→delta with idle gaps. (3) Queue stocking is mandatory: an empty stream /next queue is a driver defect unless the epic is complete — file banked follow-ups as issues the moment they are identified. (4) The existing two-sided guardrail STANDS unchanged: never manufacture busywork, quality > utilization, capacity/disk bounds per #M-14 — cite the existing 'never manufacture busywork' line rather than weakening it. Also verify the skill's frontmatter/other sections don't contradict the new section (quote any line you had to reconcile). Acceptance: the repo's prompt/skill lint if one covers skills (find it — scripts/lint/lint_agent_skills.py exists, run it, quote), plus a diff quote of the new section. Conventional commit docs(drive-epic): binding no-idle-lanes subscription min-max for all driver seats; push; open PR referencing #6943. NO auto-merge. Evidence preamble binds (#M-4).
